ground_weather_addendum.reason: Select closest complete weather series per variable, rather than requiring temperature and rain at the same more distant station. No satellite/outcome join or model results inspected.
ground_weather_addendum.selection: La Panza RAWS for TMAX/TMIN; Salinas Dam for PRCP, each >=90% source coverage. San Luis Obispo ASOS airport is a separate timeliness sensitivity. Selection by distance and coverage only.
ground_weather_addendum.specification: Rolling 48 eligible historical months, minimum 36, OLS log daily generation on intercept + 11 month indicators + linear time + the three ground weather features. Exactly same training months as time/season-only regression.

confirmation_amendment_before_goes_metri.reason: Primary EIA2022 proposed rule and respondent frequencies establish pre2023 annual respondents did not provide independent monthly generation. Use actual annual totals at CVSR, never allocated monthly estimates. No GOES outcome join or metrics examined.
confirmation_amendment_before_goes_metri.evaluation: 2022–2025 annual CVSR totals, four confirmation outcomes. Forecast January14 following production year, prior to official annual disclosures in June/July. Prior2annual labels available under conservative Nov1followingyear embargo.
confirmation_amendment_before_goes_metri.formula: Mean daily generation of prior2released annual outcomes times currentyear mean daily GOES irradiation / mean daily GOES irradiation in identical historicalyears, multiplied by targetyear daycount. Compare matched annual daily-output mean and latestreleased annual daily-output persistence; secondary pointRMSEimprovement required.
confirmation_amendment_before_goes_metri.limitation: At January14 of yearY+1, yearY-1 outcome is available after November1ofY. Four annual outcomes support only weak secondary confirmation; primary evidence remains48monthlyTopaz outcomes.
